message.content: {"ranking": [{"id": "patch_7b5a7f387d37", "failure_port": "o_wb_ack", "source_line": 582, "mechanism": "Replaces the combinational assignment `always @(posedge i_clk) o_wb_ack <= wb_stb;` with a registered one-cycle delay pipeline gated by `i_wb_cyc`, matching the oracle's expectation that `o_wb_ack` asserts one cycle after a qualified wishbone write and deasserts when `i_wb_cyc` drops."}, {"id": "patch_2643820b9fc0", "failure_port": "o_wb_ack", "source_line": 577, "mechanism": "Byte-reverses the FIFO-A read data `{fifo_a_mem_0, fifo_a_mem_1, fifo_a_mem_2, fifo_a_mem_3}` before driving `o_wb_data`, which feeds the debug/status word that the testbench samples; wrong endianness corrupts the sampled status bits and thus the `o_wb_ack` trace."}, {"id": "patch_436fc440e456", "failure_port": "o_wb_ack", "source_line": 320, "mechanism": "Guards the `r_cmd_state == 3'h4` transition with `!r_have_resp`, preventing the command transmitter from advancing to the CRC/token phase until the low-level RX path has actually captured a response token, eliminating spurious early `o_wb_ack` pulses."}, {"id": "patch_6083bec9b350", "failure_port": "o_wb_ack", "source_line": 324, "mechanism": "Guards the `r_cmd_state == 3'h5` transition with `!r_use_fifo`, ensuring the state machine does not enter the FIFO-read wait branch when no FIFO operation is configured, removing a false `o_wb_ack` assertion."}, {"id": "patch_0c0e3272c11f", "failure_port": "o_wb_ack", "source_line": 337, "mechanism": "Guards the `r_cmd_state == 3'h6` transition with `r_use_fifo`, so the FIFO-read completion wait only runs for genuine FIFO reads, preventing the state machine from stalling and missing `o_wb_ack` edges."}, {"id": "patch_f8d57d590691", "failure_port": "o_wb_ack", "source_line": 582, "mechanism": "Changes the `o_wb_ack` assignment to `o_wb_ack <= (i_wb_cyc) && wb_stb;`, directly qualifying the acknowledge with the active bus-cycle signal that the oracle toggles, aligning the ack pulse to the exact cycles where `i_wb_cyc=1`."}, {"id": "patch_1d01c9aac1b0", "failure_port": "o_wb_ack", "source_line": 471, "mechanism": "Byte-swaps the incoming wishbone write data before loading `r_data_reg`, correcting the command/clock-divider/FIFO-length fields that the state machine later transmits; a corrupted command field would desynchronize the low-level SPI and shift the `o_wb_ack` trace."}, {"id": "patch_2e7dcb4295ae", "failure_port": "o_wb_ack", "source_line": 324, "mechanism": "Guards the `r_cmd_state == 3'h5` transition with `r_use_fifo` (positive polarity), complementing patch_6083bec9b350 by ensuring the wait-for-response branch is taken only when a FIFO operation is actually configured, stabilizing the `o_wb_ack` timing."}], "explanation": "The public mismatch trace shows `o_wb_ack` toggling on cycles 6,7,11,12,15,16,19,20,24,25 instead of the expected pattern. The original code drives `o_wb_ack` purely from `wb_stb` (a wishbone write strobe) with no bus-cycle qualification, so the ack pulse appears one cycle early and does not respect `i_wb_cyc` gating. Patches in the ack_pipeline family (patch_7b5a7f387d37, patch_f8d57d590691) directly restructure this assignment into a one-cycle-delay pipeline qualified by `i_wb_cyc`, which is the minimal change to match the oracle's cycle-exact ack waveform. Remaining mismatches stem from state-machine desynchronization caused by unguarded transitions in the command/FIFO sequencer: the transmitter advances to CRC/token phases before a response is ready (`r_have_resp`), enters FIFO-read waits when no FIFO is configured (`r_use_fifo`), or stalls in the FIFO-read completion state. Patches patch_436fc440e456, patch_6083bec9b350, patch_0c0e3272c11f, and patch_2e7dcb4295ae add the missing guards on lines 320, 324, and 337, aligning the command-state progression with the low-level SPI handshake. Finally, patch_2643820b9fc0 corrects FIFO-A read endianness (line 577) so the status word returned to the wishbone bus has the expected bit layout, and patch_1d01c9aac1b0 (line 471) ensures command parameters written via the wishbone bus are byte-ordered correctly before the transmitter loads them. Together these eight patches address the direct ack-pipeline timing, the command/FIFO state-machine guards, and the two datapath endianness issues that indirectly corrupt the sampled `o_wb_ack` trace."}
